question: What is total revenue from paid invoices for tenant 1001 last month?
correct_sql: SELECT SUM(i.total_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM billing.invoices i WHERE i.tenant_id = {tenant_id} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.status = 'paid' AND i.issued_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE)) - INTERVAL '1' MONTH AND i.issued_at < DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE));

question: How many overdue invoices does tenant 1001 have?
correct_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS overdue_n FROM billing.invoices i WHERE i.tenant_id = {tenant_id} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.status = 'overdue';
